policy: Base digital identities are separated from explicit novelty, promotional, timeline, and specialized-role physical variants. When multiple ordinary pre-game print generations remain, retain the family and defer exact equivalence to visual/component comparison; when every supported candidate is explicitly specialized, record the candidate-set weakness rather than forcing a match.

Rather than forcing the base asset onto Artillery or Chrome Silver Armor, preserve the standard digital identity and flag the physical candidate set as incomplete for exact matching.

systemic_findings: A supported-candidate list containing only specialized variants must not be mistaken for evidence that the base identity lacks an ordinary physical counterpart.
Promotional/gimmick treatments such as light-up figures or chrome armor should not disambiguate ordinary digital character identities.
Later live-action-era releases can be excluded from source-equivalence when a pre-game animated-era physical counterpart already exists.
